description: This Java class defines the response object for a RetrieveFeatureProperties command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It encapsulates the retrieval result of feature properties associated with a specific thing, providing methods to create instances from JSON, serialize to JSON, and access the data fields. It extends an abstract command response and implements interfaces for thing query responses, focusing on handling feature property data.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertiesResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a retrieve feature properties command, including serialization, deserialization, and access methods for feature properties associated with a specific thing.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static methods to deserialize a JSON string or object into a RetrieveFeaturePropertiesResponse instance.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the feature whose properties are retrieved.

methods.name: getFeatureProperties
methods.description: Returns the FeatureProperties object containing the retrieved properties.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the feature properties to a JsonValue, respecting schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity JSON value and returns a new response instance.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path for this feature's properties.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the properties data to a JSON object builder for serialization.
